correctness.rationale: The normalized Hardy H2 distance to analytic type-(1,1) rationals reduces by orthogonality to maximizing (1-|p|²)|p|^(2N-4)|(p-a)/(1-ap)|². For a>0, differentiation with respect to cos(arg p) is strictly negative, forcing p=-r, and the radial logarithmic derivative L(r) strictly decreases from positive to negative, ensuring a unique global maximizer. The displayed coefficient and exact squared error follow from projection. Differentiating L establishes dr/da<0 while the pointwise radial objective strictly increases with a. Independent symbolic expansion of L(1-1/(2N)+b/N²) gives b=-(9a+1)/(8(1+a)), matching the claimed second term; log capture gives 1/(eN) with stated first correction. At a=0 rotational degeneracy and r²=(N-1)/N are correct. The inspected CHECK.py runs only supplementary finite consistency checks, not the infinite proof.
